scenario: Bitwise operators (`&`, `|`, `^`, `~`, `<<`, `>>`) require integer operands per LEXP.7.7. Applying them to a Float-typed slot is a compile-time error when the type is known statically. Pin: `where t.f & 1 != 0` on a Float slot rejects with a static-type-mismatch diagnostic. Mirror of LEXP.12.3 which pins the supported (Int) branch.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    f: Float key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.f & 1 != 0
->
    log info "x"
